camera_geometry.depth_of_field: cup and hand resolve naturally while the wall 100-180cm behind is moderately softer through real optical distance, not segmentation
camera_geometry.distortion: natural handheld normal-lens perspective without cup looming
camera_geometry.projection: rectilinear eye-level to slightly-above normal-lens projection

composition_geometry.bbox_semantics: one smaller handheld product; width 0.16-0.20 and height 0.23-0.29
composition_geometry.crop_policy: retain one whole modest product, natural grip and short bare wrist
forbidden: product width above 0.20 or height above 0.29
broad rugged palm or oversized hand
thick swollen fingers or coarse knuckles
composition_geometry.frame_rhythm: distant wall first, then a smaller cup and slender supporting hand
composition_geometry.negative_space: 0.68-0.78 meaningful distant wall and broad partial light variation

support_plane.kind: distant vertical warm-white plaster wall behind a held product
support_plane.perspective: wall 100-180cm behind the product with attenuated detail and no ground-plane reading

invariants: one smaller exact sleeve-free handheld product
one slender fine-boned natural hand and short bare wrist
conditional straw is colorless optically clear or absent according to the chosen container
one upper-right window source with broad off-frame occlusion
composition_variation.repeat_guard: never recreate the reference acid. mark, paper sleeve, exact hand, sharp connected shadow or close-wall geometry
composition_variation.selection: derive only a minor hand entry, product x-offset and sun-patch edge from the request seed

creative_direction.art_direction: one smaller naturally held beverage supported by a slender fine-boned hand, seen from eye level to slightly above against a distant textured warm-white wall
creative_direction.audience: a Tokyo concept-store buyer and a senior lifestyle merchandiser
creative_direction.desired_response: a quiet, natural frame that earns attention through proportion, air and believable light
creative_direction.restraint: one smaller product, one refined natural hand, one wall and one sunlight idea

finish_signature.acuity: finite near-plane phone acuity with moderate distant-wall softness
finish_signature.depth_rendering: hand-cup overlap, focus separation, background detail attenuation and broad shadow falloff establish real wall distance
finish_signature.grain: subtle shared luminance sensor texture with no beauty smoothing
finish_signature.microcontrast: fine on tapered fingers, natural nail edges and cup rim; reduced on the distant wall
finish_signature.retouching: retain fine skin lines, subtle pressure and small color variation; reject rugged exaggeration and beauty smoothing

lighting_geometry.highlight_behavior: bright direct-sun rim and skin response below clipping
lighting_geometry.optical_effects: transparent containers preserve beverage-colored transmitted light inside the compact shadow
lighting_geometry.source_topology: one upper-right direct window source with neutral room bounce and broad partial occlusion from window frames and furniture outside the frame

hard_fail: exact product count differs from one
product width exceeds 0.20 or height exceeds 0.29
hand is oversized, broad-palmed, rugged, thick-fingered or coarse-knuckled
a required straw is gray, green, beige, black, metallic or opaque instead of colorless optically clear plastic
a straw is invented when the selected source or container policy says none
camera pitch is below 2 degrees or an upward/low-angle reading appears
paper sleeve, holder, wrap or cuff appears
wall reads close, sharp or in the same focal plane as the cup
skin is waxy, airbrushed, uniform or anatomically malformed
contrast crushes hand or beverage shadows, or clips the white wall

reference_binding.runtime_role: offline handheld geometry and direct-sun authority

tone_signature.black_point: open neutral shadow with skin and transparent-material detail
tone_signature.contrast_curve: contrast +2% versus v3; real direct-sun separation with open shadows and a soft protected highlight shoulder
tone_signature.local_contrast: moderate at grip, cup rim and liquid boundary; only a very slight overall increase
tone_signature.material_separation: wall, skin, cup material and beverage remain distinct under one direct source
tone_signature.saturation: quiet wall and skin; exact beverage color remains source-authoritative
tone_signature.shadow_color: slightly cooler neutral than the sunlit wall
